name: Brand and responsive website
deliverable: Selected brand applied to home, navigation, category, product, basket and checkout; desktop/mobile and essential error/loading states.
acceptance: Owner approves the chosen design and can shop on a phone.

name: Catalogue and discovery
deliverable: Categories, keyword/SKU search, essential filters, pagination and clear in-stock/out-of-stock display.
acceptance: A buyer finds a known item by SKU and category.

name: Accurate product pages
deliverable: Images, manufacturer reference, variant/pack size, approved description, applicable documents, price/tax and delivery information.
acceptance: Page matches the physical item and approved product record.

name: Guest and customer accounts
deliverable: Guest buying, verified-email registration, sign-in/reset, saved addresses and own order history.
acceptance: Customers can buy and view only their own orders.

name: Professional purchase controls
deliverable: Application and human verification, reviewer notes, approved entitlement and server-side restricted-item checks.
acceptance: A pending or ineligible buyer cannot pay for a restricted item.

name: Basket and checkout
deliverable: Quantity changes, authoritative prices/stock, tax/delivery totals, address validation, final review and clear payment confirmation.
acceptance: Altered browser prices and unavailable quantities are rejected.

name: Revolut and wallets
deliverable: Revolut checkout with Apple Pay/Google Pay where approved and supported; verified payment events and failure/retry handling.
acceptance: Supported device/browser completes a verified test payment; failures do not dispatch.

name: PayPal
deliverable: PayPal checkout, verified capture/refund events and order reconciliation.
acceptance: Duplicate or late events cannot cause duplicate dispatch/refund.

name: Customer information and email
deliverable: Seller/contact pages, delivery/returns/privacy/terms, order confirmation, dispatch and refund messages.
acceptance: Customer receives correct totals, terms and useful order updates.

name: Search and consent foundation
deliverable: Metadata/canonicals, sitemap, product data, mobile accessibility, consent/preferences and approved-product feed export.
acceptance: Audits pass; rejected tracking stays off; ineligible items stay out of feeds.

name: Secure staff workspace
deliverable: Invite-only staff, MFA, role checks, audit history and a focused order/review/stock dashboard.
acceptance: Customer credentials cannot enter admin or change staff permissions.

name: Product management and imports
deliverable: Create/edit/archive products, categories, prices, variants and evidence; CSV draft import with errors/duplicates and preview.
acceptance: 250 planned records can be reviewed; an additional product needs no code change.

name: Images and documents
deliverable: Upload-time validation/optimisation, prepared responsive images in R2 and separately protected private evidence.
acceptance: Approved media loads quickly; private evidence has no public URL.

name: Stock and traceability
deliverable: Receipt/opening counts, adjustments, reservations, applicable lot/serial/expiry, quarantine and a movement audit trail.
acceptance: Last-unit contention cannot oversell; held/expired stock cannot be bought.

name: Orders and dispatch
deliverable: Paid/held/failed queues, pick/pack record, manual carrier booking/tracking entry and partial fulfilment where needed.
acceptance: Staff can trace order lines to the stock dispatched.

name: Returns and refunds
deliverable: Return request logging, authorised full/partial refunds, returned-stock quarantine and recall/hold records.
acceptance: Refund amount never exceeds captured funds less previous refunds.

name: Financial records and exports
deliverable: Order/invoice/credit-note records, tax snapshots, basic sales/stock exports and payment reconciliation exceptions.
acceptance: Finance can reconcile an order, refund and provider settlement reference.

name: Product/channel approval
deliverable: Draft/review/approved/held states; distinct territory, buyer, payment and feed eligibility.
acceptance: A suspended item cannot remain purchasable through an old URL or basket.

name: Hosting and recovery
deliverable: Hostinger apps/API/PostgreSQL; Cloudflare domain/R2; TLS, private database, secrets, logs, alerts, backups and tested restore.
acceptance: A clean environment can restore an order and stock history from backup.

name: Training and launch controls
deliverable: Owner walkthrough, staff SOPs, defect log, deployment/rollback procedure and release evidence.
acceptance: Business team completes receive -> publish -> buy -> ship -> refund.
